2608.19889.title: Write Once, Run Everywhere: The Axon DSL for Shape-Safe and Framework-Agnostic LLM Architectures
2608.19889.paper_summary: The entire ecosystem of open-source language models effectively relies on a single platform. What if this platform was forced to shut down tomorrow? Implementing and maintaining efficient model definitions and translating them between different training and inference regimes is a resource-heavy task that severely limits model efficiency and portability, hindering both scaling and deployment. Here, we present Axon, a strongly typed domain-specific language with Haskell-like syntax, that enables a write-once, run everywhere paradigm for LLM architectures. By basing collaboration on a language specification rather than a specific framework's vision, Axon fosters open cooperation and empowers researchers to implement highly specialized architectures without giving up optimization infrastructure or accepting deployment lock-in. Axon allows for concise, auditable specifications that can be automatically compiled to standalone implementations for leading frameworks: PyTorch, PyTorch with Triton, JAX, MLX and vLLM. In 467 inference benchmarking experiments on models ranging from 135M to 32B parameters, we demonstrate median speedups of 7% on PyTorch, 12% on PyTorch with Triton, 91% on JAX, and 107% on MLX, compared to the reference implementations from Transformers. When deployed as native vLLM architectures with PagedAttention and KV-cache, Axon models achieve a 58% median speedup over Transformers implementations.
2608.19889.paper_summary_zh: 整個開源語言模型的生態系統有效地依賴於一個單一平台。假如這個平台明天被迫關閉會怎樣？實施和維護高效的模型定義，並在不同的訓練和推理模式之間進行轉換，是一項資源密集型的任務，這嚴重限制了模型的效率和可攜性，妨礙了擴展和部署。在這裡，我們介紹了Axon，一種具有Haskell類似語法的強類型領域特定語言，它使得LLM架構能夠實現一次編寫、隨處運行的範式。通過基於語言規範而非特定框架的願景來促進合作，Axon促進了開放合作，並使研究人員能夠實現高度專門化的架構，而不必放棄優化基礎設施或接受部署鎖定。Axon允許簡潔、可審計的規範，這些規範可以自動編譯為主要框架的獨立實現：PyTorch、帶有Triton的PyTorch、JAX、MLX和vLLM。在對從135M到32B參數的模型進行的467次推理基準測試中，我們展示了在PyTorch上中位數加速7%、在帶有Triton的PyTorch上12%、在JAX上91%以及在MLX上107%的速度提升，與Transformers的參考實現相比。當作為原生vLLM架構與PagedAttention和KV-cache部署時，Axon模型在Transformers實現上實現了58%的中位數加速。
